messages:
alex: quick sync — we need to lock priority for customer-managed networking in the private distro. field asks: preserve customer IPs across upgrades, staged rollback, and a small installer handshake. do we go minimal or full?

maria: +1. propose 2 lanes: minimal (routing + installer handshake + docs) and full (tenant isolation, IPAM migration tool, audited rollout).

taylor: minimal seems unblockable for Q2 if we focus scope: installer hooks, a small API for handshake, and sanity e2e. minimal estimate ~3 eng-weeks. full ~10 wks. blockers: ipam lib and windows agent quirks.

sam: customers require deterministic upgrade windows and ability to opt-out of automated IP reassignments. migration tool is non-negotiable for big accounts.

alex: draft acceptance criteria for minimal lane: 1) installer handshake API accepts preferred_ip_list and returns reserved_ips; 2) idempotent installer run across N upgrades; 3) rollout toggle that forces fallback to hosted runtime. if any fail, fall back to opt-in minimal.

maria: add field requirement: netops sign-off checklist (peering, ACLs, ip-preservation test). they will reject if we don't provide a clear rollback doc.

taylor: quick example handshake payload for minimal lane (for the docs):
```
POST /install/handshake
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-123",
  "preferred_ips": ["10.1.0.0/24"],
  "preferred_gateways": ["10.1.0.1"]
}
```
response: reserved_ips + ttl

sam: timeline suggestion: prioritize minimal + migration tool parallel work. ship minimal to pilot customers in 2 sprints, migration tool early beta end of sprint 3.

alex: decision: minimal lane = P0 for next sprint. full lane stays P1 with a gating ticket for ipam lib work. owners: taylor -> minimal lane, sam -> migration tool, maria -> field comms & netops checklist. i'll add canary gating and rollout doc to roadmap.

devops-bot: build-status: minimal-installer: passed (ci/42) :white_check_mark:

maria: :thumbsup: i'll draft the netops checklist and sync with acme netops next Tue.

taylor: will open the minimal PRs today and add e2e playbook.

sam: i'll scope migration tool API and share an initial design by EOD Friday.

alex: thanks. keep updates in this thread — i'll update roadmap ticket and block sprint planning until we confirm owners. :rocket:
